samples.question: A vertical timeline of four panels reads top to bottom. Each panel shows four slots (slot 1 to slot 4, left to right) and each slot holds one token. Every token has its own fixed color that never changes. A magenta ring in the first (top) panel marks the token you must track. Between consecutive panels, a cyan exchange mark joins two adjacent slots, meaning those two tokens swap positions as you move to the next panel. Reading the panels in order and following the swap marks, which slot does the ringed token occupy in the last (bottom) panel? Answer 'slot 1', 'slot 2', 'slot 3', or 'slot 4'.
